record.field: Shared pjsip wizard templates included once at the top of the generated peers file. No variables.

; Generated by Oduist Connect. Include from pjsip_wizard.conf: ; #exec curl -s "https://odoo.example.com/asterisk/api/sip_peers?token=..."
[webrtc-user](!) type = wizard transport = transport-wss accepts_registrations = yes sends_registrations = no accepts_auth = yes sends_auth = no endpoint/webrtc = yes endpoint/dtls_auto_generate_cert = yes endpoint/context = from-internal endpoint/allow = !all,g722,alaw,ulaw endpoint/direct_media = no endpoint/force_rport = yes endpoint/rewrite_contact = yes endpoint/rtp_symmetric = yes endpoint/allow_transfer = yes endpoint/send_diversion = yes endpoint/ice_support = yes endpoint/inband_progress = yes aor/qualify_frequency = 30 aor/authenticate_qualify = no aor/max_contacts = 5 aor/remove_existing = yes aor/minimum_expiration = 30 aor/support_path = yes

One pjsip wizard peer per Connect endpoint.
Variables: sip_user - SIP username (PJSIP/101 -> 101) sip_password - SIP credential passphrase transport - udp / tcp / webrtc (maps to the wizard template) name - Endpoint display name

AMI account for the sidecar agent, to be included in manager.conf on the PBX.
Variables: ami_user - AMI username ami_password - AMI secret

; Oduist Connect agent AMI account. Include from manager.conf. [{{ ami_user }}] secret = {{ ami_password }} deny = 0.0.0.0/0.0.0.0 permit = 127.0.0.1/255.255.255.255 ; Add the docker bridge / agent host subnet, e.g.: ; permit = 172.17.0.0/255.255.0.0 read = call,dialplan,user write = originate,call,reporting ; Optional noise reduction on busy systems: ; eventfilter = Event: Newchannel ; eventfilter = Event: Newstate ; eventfilter = Event: NewConnectedLine ; eventfilter = Event: Hangup ; eventfilter = Event: OriginateResponse ; eventfilter = Variable: MIXMONITOR_FILENAME
